Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters

Requirements:

Begin screenplay.

Title: A LIFE REMEMBERED

FADE IN:

INT. SMALL TOWN COFFEE SHOP - MORNING

A crowd of locals gather around the counter, sipping their coffee. The sun peeks through the windows, casting long shadows.

SARAH (30s, kind eyes, a hint of sadness) stands by the counter, looking out at the town. She exchanges pleasantries with the others before ordering her usual.

CASHIER (50s, grumpy but friendly)
Morning, Sarah. Same as always?

SARAH
(smiling)
Yes, please.

INT. SARAH'S APARTMENT - LIVING ROOM - LATER

Sarah sits on her worn-out couch, surrounded by old photographs and mementos. Her eyes well up as she reminisces about her late husband, MARK.

INT. SARAH'S APARTMENT - KITCHEN - NIGHT

Sarah cooks dinner, humming an old tune. Memories flood back as she recalls Mark's favorite meal. She pauses, staring at the empty chair across from her.

Suddenly, there's a knock at the door. Sarah hesitates before answering.

INT. SARAH'S APARTMENT - ENTRANCE - NIGHT

Sarah opens the door to find TOM (40s, Mark's best friend), holding a bouquet of flowers.

TOM
(quietly)
I heard you were having a tough time. I wanted to pay my respects.

Sarah invites Tom in, and they share stories about Mark. The night passes in quiet companionship.

INT. SMALL TOWN PARK - DAY

Sarah sits on a bench in the park, watching the children play. Tom joins her, and they share laughter as they watch the world go by.

SARAH
(smiling)
Mark would have loved to see this.

Tom places a hand on Sarah's shoulder, offering comfort.

TOMS
We'll make sure he's never forgotten.

INT. SMALL TOWN MEMORIAL GARDEN - EVENING

Sarah and Tom join the townsfolk for a memorial service for Mark. They release lanterns into the sky, each one representing a memory of Mark.

INT. SMALL TOWN COFFEE SHOP - MORNING - ONE YEAR LATER

Sarah enters the coffee shop, now a regular. She exchanges greetings with the locals, feeling a sense of belonging and healing.

FADE OUT.

THE END
